intro: Style that lasts, comfort that stays. In striking shades and plush upholstery, the Prime chair delivers the perfect mix of sophistication and ergonomic ease—ensuring you work in comfort, year after year.

features.title: Class that lasts
features.text: Style that lasts, comfort that stays. In striking shades and plush upholstery, this chair delivers the perfect mix of sophistication and ergonomic ease—ensuring you work in comfort, year after year.

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and centre tilt mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Comfortable quilted back
features.text: The back is made up of injection moulded glass filled nylon & upholstered using Quilted fabric.It embodies the players who cant wait to get comfortable at the top.

features.title: Armrests that adjust to you
features.text: Find the perfect arm position with height-adjustable arms, designed to align with your desk and reduce shoulder strain.

name: Prime Full Back Knitted Fabric Workstation Chair
